title: YummyPack
description: MrYummy's Mods recommended for alle Gawklos Members and a flawless Gaming Experience.
body:
This Modpack is for all Gawklos members who want to use MrYummy's Mods. For now it features over 30 mods that reach from pure performance mods such as Sodium, FerriteCore or ImmediatlyFast to simple Quality of life Mods like Cut Through, Gamma Utils or Xaero's Mini Map to make your Minecraft Experience even better.

Watch Out!

Continuity and Distant Horizons are not featured on this Modpack and have to be installed manually.

This Pack also doesn't feature any Data Packs or Plugins.

I wisch ju very much fun wth sis päck. 😘
